summary: Challenge to High Court's order allowing arbitration petition under Section 11(6) of Arbitration Act; dispute arose over Bank Guarantees following Settlement Agreement dated 27.05.2020; petitioner alleged accord and satisfaction while respondent claimed coercion; High Court appointed arbitrator; Supreme Court analyzed pre-referral jurisdiction scope; held Section 11(6) applications require limited scrutiny to ascertain prima facie arbitrability; no determination on merits of settlement validity or economic duress at referral stage; affirmed High Court's limited review approach.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's order allowing arbitration petition upheld; arbitration proceedings permitted to continue.
